# clonometer

> A GitHub Action that samples a repository's clone count every day and keeps the lifetime total, because GitHub reports only the last 14 days.

- [Site](https://oficiallyakshay.github.io/clonometer/): the machine, with the live clone numbers
- [Repository](https://github.com/oficiallyAkshay/clonometer): source, README and install steps
- [Licence](https://github.com/oficiallyAkshay/clonometer/blob/main/LICENSE): MIT
